issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]の近[ちか]くなのに、電車[でんしゃ]は{めったに|av-mettani}使[つか]いません。
issues.problem: English 'Although it is near the station' has an unclear 'it'.
issues.action: English changed to 'Even though I live near the station, I hardly ever take the train.'

issues.jp_before: 試験[しけん]の前[まえ]に{ろくに|av-mettani}勉強[べんきょう]しなかったので、試験[しけん]に落[お]ちました。
issues.problem: Distractor めったに works here too ('I rarely studied before the exam'), and the English 'hardly studied' fits both readings. 試験 is also repeated.
issues.action: Rewritten to a single occasion: 前[まえ]の晩[ばん]に{ろくに}勉強[べんきょう]しなかったので、試験[しけん]に落[お]ちてしまった。 / 'I barely studied the night before'. Why updated.

issues.jp_before: 日本人[にほんじん]が{必[かなら]ずしも|av-mettani}納豆[なっとう]を好[す]きなわけではありません。
issues.problem: 納豆を好き is colloquial; the standard form to model is 納豆が好き.
issues.action: Changed to 納豆[なっとう]が好[す]きなわけではありません.

issues.jp_before: 雨[あめ]の日[ひ]を{必[かなら]ずしも|av-mettani}嫌[いや]だと思[おも]う人[ひと]ばかりではない。
issues.problem: Awkward: 必ずしも sits inside the relative clause, and 雨の日を嫌だと思う is unnatural.
issues.action: Rewritten: みんなが{必[かなら]ずしも}雨[あめ]の日[ひ]を嫌[いや]がるわけではない。 Same English. Why updated.

issues.jp_before: 医者[いしゃ]に止[と]められて、今[いま]はお酒[さけ]を{一切[いっさい]|av-mettani}飲[の]みません。
issues.problem: English 'The doctor has stopped me' is an unnatural rendering of 医者に止められて.
issues.action: English changed to 'My doctor told me to stop, so now I don't drink any alcohol at all.'

issues.jp_before: 社内[しゃない]のこの話[はなし]は{一切[いっさい]|av-mettani}口外[こうがい]しないでください。
issues.problem: 社内のこの話 is unnatural, and the English 'outside the company' is not in the Japanese.
issues.action: Rewritten: この話[はなし]は社外[しゃがい]の人[ひと]には{一切[いっさい]}話[はな]さないでください。 / 'Please don't tell anyone outside the company about this at all.'

issues.jp_before: バスが{なかなか|av-nakanaka}来[こ]ないので、歩[ある]いて行[い]くことにした。
issues.problem: English 'The bus wasn't coming' does not convey 'slow in coming', so it does not rule out たまたま ('happened not to come').
issues.action: English changed to 'The bus just wasn't coming, so I decided to walk.'

issues.jp_before: 今夜[こんや]は暑[あつ]くて{なかなか|av-nakanaka}眠[ねむ]れない。
issues.problem: Distractor きっと gives natural Japanese (暑くてきっと眠れない, 'I surely won't be able to sleep'), close to the English.
issues.action: Replaced きっと with 必[かなら]ず.

issues.jp_before: この問題[もんだい]は{なかなか|av-nakanaka}解[と]けません。
issues.problem: Distractor きっと is natural (きっと解けません, 'I surely can't solve it'), close to 'I just can't solve this problem'.
issues.action: Replaced きっと with 必[かなら]ず.

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]は約束[やくそく]の時間[じかん]になってもなかなか{来[こ]ない|av-nakanaka}。
issues.problem: English 'Even when the appointed time comes, he doesn't show up' is stilted and does not carry the 'still' sense.
issues.action: English changed to 'The agreed time has come, but he still hasn't shown up.'

issues.jp_before: 彼女[かのじょ]は人見知[ひとみし]りで、{なかなか|av-nakanaka}友達[ともだち]ができないそうだ。
issues.problem: Distractor とても + potential-like できない ('can't possibly make friends') is grammatical and close in meaning.
issues.action: Replaced とても with たまたま.

issues.jp_before: この漢字[かんじ]は、何度[なんど]書[か]いても{なかなか|av-nakanaka}覚[おぼ]えられない。
issues.problem: Distractor きっと is natural (何度書いてもきっと覚えられない) and close to the English.
issues.action: Replaced きっと with 必[かなら]ず.

issues.jp_before: 新[あたら]しい仕事[しごと]に{なかなか|av-nakanaka}慣[な]れません。
issues.problem: Distractor きっと gives a possible prediction reading (きっと慣れません), close to 'I can't seem to get used to'.
issues.action: Replaced きっと with たまたま.
